It's been about ten months since I kidnapped Hazuki.
I was supposed to spend this time to make her compliant and
obedient. I tried various training methods on her, everything
I could think of that might help, but...
Hazuki didn't give up. She held strong and kept her sanity, as well
as her identity. I felt so close to success for the longest time, but
in the end I wasn't able to make her mine the way I wanted to.
Oh, I did manage to do at least one thing right, that's for sure...\|
That's right. She's carrying a baby inside her. Hazuki is pregnant.
Getting her pregnant was one of the many things I tried during
her training. To make things even more agonizing for her, we
don't really know who the father is.
It was bound to happen, really. We've been fucking without
protection day after day after day... We both knew it.
Her belly's so swollen that anyone could tell at a glance.
So while I couldn't make her submit to me completely, which was
the original plan, knocking her up and witnessing the pain in her
eyes as the baby grew bigger was somewhat amusing nonetheless.
The real nightmare will begin for her soon enough. I can feel
my dick swell in my pants at the thought of that moment
finally coming... It won't be long now. Not long at all.
(No... I don't want this!)
(I don't want a baby... I don't want to become a mother!)
(I don't want to become a mother... The mother of his child!)
(.\..\..\.That nightmare again.)
(I've been having it every other night recently.)
(In it, he slowly but surely trains me, and I become more obedient
to him with time... It's obvious that I lose myself in the process.)
(But every time I have this nightmare, I'm reminded of the truth.
That girl isn't me, not really. That's not how I feel about him.)
(Why...? Why did this happen to me?)
(Please, let me go... If this is a nightmare, I want to wake up!)
(I don't wanna be here.\..\..\. I don't wannaaaa...)
